name: Vice City Sickout
hook: Fake your cough, dodge your boss on Teams, and grind launch day
tagline: You sit on the sofa holding a glow controller while drafting outrageous excuse emails to HR as the economy bleeds billions. Cash out to submit a forged medical note and speed off in an open-world sports car. Crash and your webcam turns on mid-Slack huddle wearing neon sunglasses.
